programmes.d: Quint Asper becomes the unwilling object of a girl’s affections when her harried parents travel through Dodge City.
Matt Dillon pursues a murderer-bank robber into Mexico only to end up with his prisoner in a Mexican jail.
Matt Dillon and his prisoner, Charlie Hacker, get released from a Mexican jail, but meet a gang of bandits while riding toward Texas.
An itinerant medicine man and his daughter find only tragedy when they attempt to sell their wares in Dodge City.
An eccentric transient and his motley offspring bring tragedy to a peace-loving rancher and his family.
Matt Dillon comes to the aid of an innocent wolf hunter who discovers that a local rancher is butchering cattle illegally.
The life of a small girl is endangered because she is the only witness to the shooting of her mother.
Ramon's parents are killed by men of landowner John Barrett. While trying to get revenge, Ramon is wounded but has saved the life of Rezza, an old disillusioned killer. Feat: George Eastman.
Two Indian-style murders on a Dodge City street threaten to start a full-scale panic among the jittery townspeople.
The ambitious wife of a new doctor tries to steal patients away from Doc Adams by spreading rumors that old Doc is an alcoholic.
The father of a rag-tag family of seven offers to sell his teenaged daughter to Marshal Dillon as a wife.
Festus Haggen’s hillbilly nephew, Eliab, comes to Dodge City to settle a score with Festus.
An old friend of Kitty's travels West for the sole purpose of aiding her fugitive son's wife in childbirth.
A shaggy gold prospector boasts of striking it rich, then indulges in a spending spree, which he soon regrets.
A pretty young woman tries to leave an outlaw gang for a new life in Dodge City but is tricked into changing her mind.
A vengeful judge accuses Kitty and Festus of conspiracy in the killing of his son.
Fronted by a gun salesman, outlaws on a bank-robbing spree across the west head for Dodge City.
After robbing the bank, the outlaws kidnap Doc Adams and set fire to Dodge City to cover their getaway.
A boy's love for his guitar—all that is left from his late father's estate—leads to murder and a trail of trouble.
A gunman kills a young challenger and becomes a target for revenge—from his own son, as well as the victim's family.
A gang steals a gigantic bar of gold and commandeers the Dodge City blacksmith shop in order to divide the loot.
An embittered ranch woman holds Matt Dillon and Kitty prisoner while plotting Matt's execution to avenge her husband's hanging.
Marshal Dillon is helped by a friendly young runaway who later faces him as a deadly adversary.
